name: Greiner CELLSTAR 655180 96 well
author: Ramona Optics
notes: Greiner Bio-One CELLSTAR 96 well cell culture microplate, PS, F-bottom chimney well, SOLID clear polystyrene bottom (not a uClear film), cell culture treated, sterile, with a clear lid with condensation rings, single packed. Dimensions from Greiner customer drawing rev 9, released 2025-12-04, '96 Well Microplate, PS, F-Bottom, Chimney Well', valid for 655080/655081/655160/655162/655180/655181/655182/655184/655185; page 1 of that drawing is the plate and page 2 is the lid. Units in meters. Footprint 127.76 x 85.48 mm +/- 0.2, plate height 14.4 mm +/- 0.1 WITHOUT the lid (the lid is a separate 127.5 x 85 x 10 mm part on page 2 of the drawing and is not included in any dimension here), flange/skirt height 2.5 mm, plate curvature max difference 0.20 mm. Well spacing (pitch) 9 mm. A1 well center is 14.38 mm from the left edge (A1 column offset) and 11.24 mm from the top edge (A1 row offset). Well top diameter 6.96 mm, bottom diameter 6.58 mm, depth 10.9 mm, flat chimney-well bottom. The Greiner Microplate Dimensions Guide brochure (F073027) prints the top diameter for this chimney-well group as 6.69 mm, which conflicts with the 6.96 mm on the controlled per-catalogue drawing; the drawing value is used here, the same call already recorded for 655090. The brochure is the only source for the well bottom elevation, 3.5 mm, consistent with 14.4 - 10.9 = 3.5. Greiner publishes no well bottom thickness for this part - the bottom is solid moulded PS, not the 190 um uClear film of 655090 - so the working-distance offset through the base is unpublished and must be measured if it matters. Product data sheet PDS 6551xx rev 10 (released 2025-06-04) gives colour (plate clear, lid clear), material PS free of heavy metal, physical surface treatment, sterile SAL 10-3, total well volume 392 uL (mathematically calculated), working volume 25-340 uL, growth area 34 mm^2, shelf life 4 years; its section 1.2 defers dimensions to the customer drawing. Sibling part numbers on the same mould: 655160 (same plate, no lid), 655162 (5/bag), 655182 (10/bag), 655185 (hydrophobic, untreated), 655080/655081/655184 (MICROLON ELISA variants). This part is NOT the same mould as Greiner_655161 (F-bottom standard, solid, untreated, no lid, plate height 14.6 mm, well bottom diameter 6.39 mm, 382 uL) and shares the chimney-well mould with Greiner_655090, which differs from it in bottom (uClear 190 um film vs solid PS) and plate colour (black vs clear). Greiner makes no ANSI/SBS compliance claim on this drawing, though the footprint matches the standard. Use 'pitch' and origin reference to compute all well centers.
